entities.summary: The Synagogue des Tournelles is an Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on the Rue des Tournelles, in the Marais district, in the IVe arrondissement of Paris, France. The building was dedicated on 15 September 1876, during Jewish New Year celebrations.
